name: TWIN TREES Waffle House, Pizzeria, Restaurant and Wine Boutique
address: 29 Lang St, Bergsig, Great Brak River, 6525, South Africa
description_short: Family-run waffle house and pizzeria in Great Brak River with wood-fired pizzas and boutique wines.
description_long:
Tucked away on Lang Street in Great Brak River, Twin Trees is a relaxed family spot that does three things well: waffles, wood-fired pizzas, and a carefully curated wine selection. The casual atmosphere makes it easy to settle in whether you're stopping for breakfast with the kids or sharing a pizza and bottle of wine in the evening.

The waffle menu covers sweet and savoury options, while the pizzeria serves proper wood-fired bases with generous toppings. Their wine boutique adds a nice touch, offering bottles you won't find everywhere else along the Garden Route. It's the kind of place where regulars know the owners and visitors feel welcome without any fuss.

Located just off the N2 between Mossel Bay and George, Twin Trees works as both a destination and a convenient stop. The garden setting provides a peaceful backdrop, and the kitchen keeps things honest — good ingredients, straightforward preparation, fair prices.
